# Taskmaster Tool & Command Reference

This document provides a detailed reference for interacting with Taskmaster, covering both the recommended MCP tools and the corresponding `task-master` CLI commands.

Note: For integrated environments like VS Code, prefer the MCP tools for better structure and error handling; the CLI is a fallback for direct terminal use.
